name: chainguard-node-example
description: Chainguard vs Alpine Node.js container comparison

scripts.build:all: npm run build:alpine && npm run build:chainguard
scripts.compare: echo '=== Alpine ===' && docker images node-alpine --format 'Size: {{.Size}}' && echo '=== Chainguard ===' && docker images node-chainguard --format 'Size: {{.Size}}'
